# Types

Every interface and type alias exported from `packages/crouton-core/app/types`. The description is the JSDoc above each declaration.

## CroutonAppRoute

A route that can be registered in the navigation sidebar.
Routes can be nested via children for hierarchical navigation.

| Member | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The path segment for the route. Will be prefixed appropriately based on context (dashboard/admin). |
| `label` | `string` | yes | Translation key for the route label. Should be a valid i18n key that resolves to the display text. |
| `icon` | `string` | no | Optional icon class for the route. Uses Lucide icons with 'i-lucide-' prefix. |
| `children` | `CroutonAppRoute[]` | no | Optional nested routes for hierarchical navigation. Children will be displayed as sub-items in the navigation. |
| `badge` | `string \| number` | no | Optional badge text to display next to the route. Useful for showing counts or status indicators. |
| `hidden` | `boolean` | no | Whether to hide this route from the navigation. The route still exists but won't appear in sidebars. |

_Source: `packages/crouton-core/app/types/app.ts`_

## CroutonPageType

A page type that an app provides for CMS use.
Page types are pre-built templates/components that render specific app functionality.
Admins can create pages of these types in the page management UI.

| Member | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Unique identifier for this page type within the app. Combined with appId creates global uniqueness: 'bookings:calendar' |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Display name for the page type. Shown in admin UI when selecting page type. |
| `description` | `string` | yes | Description of what this page type provides. REQUIRED — shown beneath the name in the page-type picker so authors and editors can tell types apart. Use an i18n key (translated at render). |
| `icon` | `string` | yes | Icon for the page type. REQUIRED — shown in the page-type picker. Uses Lucide icons with the 'i-lucide-' prefix. |
| `component` | `string` | yes | The Vue component name to render for this page type. Must be a globally registered component from the app package. |
| `defaultProps` | `Record<string, unknown>` | no | Default props to pass to the component. Page-specific overrides can be stored in the page record. |
| `configSchema` | `CroutonPageTypeConfigField[]` | no | Configuration schema for page-specific settings. These appear in the admin form when creating/editing a page of this type. |
| `category` | `string` | no | Category for organizing page types in the UI. |
| `requiresAuth` | `boolean` | no | Whether this page type requires authentication. |
| `previewImage` | `string` | no | Preview image URL for the page type. Shown in admin selection UI. |
| `preferredLayout` | `'default' \| 'full-height' \| 'full-screen'` | no | Preferred layout for this page type. Used as default when creating pages of this type. |
| `collection` | `string` | no | Links this page type to a collection for publishable collections. When set, the page form shows a collection item picker and the renderer fetches and displays the selected collection item. |
| `hasBlockContent` | `boolean` | no | Whether this page type uses the block editor for content. When true, the admin editor shows the block editor (like regular pages) AND can also show configSchema fields below it. Regular pages always have block content; this flag is for non-regular page types that also need block-based content editing. |
| `singleton` | `boolean` | no | Whether only one page of this type should exist per team. When true, the admin UI warns when trying to create a second instance. |

_Source: `packages/crouton-core/app/types/app.ts`_

## CroutonAppConfig

Configuration for a Crouton app that can register routes
across different navigation contexts (dashboard, admin, settings).

| Member | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Unique identifier for the app. Used as the key in the croutonApps registry. |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Display name for the app. Used in UI elements that reference the app. |
| `icon` | `string` | no | Optional icon for the app. Used when displaying the app in lists or headers. |
| `dashboardRoutes` | `CroutonAppRoute[]` | no | Routes to display in the user dashboard sidebar. These are team-scoped routes available to all team members. Paths will be prefixed with '/dashboard/[team]'. |
| `adminRoutes` | `CroutonAppRoute[]` | no | Routes to display in the admin sidebar. These are admin-only routes for managing the app. Paths will be prefixed with '/admin/[team]' or '/super-admin'. |
| `settingsRoutes` | `CroutonAppRoute[]` | no | Routes to display in the settings section of admin. These appear under a "Settings" group in the admin sidebar. Paths will be prefixed appropriately. |
| `landingRoute` | `CroutonAppRoute` | no | When set, the sidebar shows only this single route as a clickable app header, ignoring all other adminRoutes. Useful for apps that want to present as a single landing page. |
| `parentApp` | `string` | no | Optional parent app ID. When set, this app's routes are merged into the parent app's sidebar section instead of appearing standalone. Useful for layers/packages that extend an existing app. |
| `apiRoutes` | `string[]` | no | API route prefixes provided by this app. Used by crouton-devtools to extend operation tracking beyond the standard `/api/crouton-collection/` prefix. Each entry is a path prefix string (e.g. '/api/crouton-bookings/'). The tracker matches incoming requests against these prefixes and groups them by app ID. |
| `pageTypes` | `CroutonPageType[]` | no | Page types this app provides for CMS use. These appear in the admin page creation flow, allowing admins to create pages that render app-specific components. |

_Source: `packages/crouton-core/app/types/app.ts`_

## LayoutAxisSizing

Fill/hug sizing descriptor (#986) — "the component decides its own size" as
declared data. Per axis: `fill` stretches to the pane, `hug` sizes to its own
content (a Top bar declares `height: 'hug'` → a short bar wherever it lands,
with no per-instance size UI). Qualitative intent, distinct from the px contract
(`minWidth` etc.) on the definition below; the renderer + `deriveSizing` read it.
Absent ⇒ `DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZING` (fully `fill`).

```ts
type LayoutAxisSizing = 'fill' | 'hug'
```

_Source: `packages/crouton-core/app/types/layout-block.ts`_

## LayoutBreakpoint

An authored responsive breakpoint (WS5, #874) — a layout adapts in two
complementary layers: *intrinsic* (every region reflows to its own width via
container queries, recursively) and *explicit* (these breakpoints, authored
"by demonstration"). A breakpoint is a **min-width checkpoint that locks
upward**: it applies for every container width `>= minWidth`. The base tree
(`LayoutTree.root`, nothing collapsed, no variant overrides) is the floor
below the smallest breakpoint.

| Member | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `minWidth` | `number` | yes | Container width (px) at and above which this breakpoint applies. |
| `label` | `string` | no | Human label for the ruler checkpoint (e.g. `'Tablet'`, `'Desktop'`). |
| `root` | `LayoutNode` | no | A full arrangement override for this breakpoint — when present it replaces `LayoutTree.root` from `minWidth` up (the "arrange at a width and it locks" demonstration). Omit to keep the base arrangement and only tweak the dials below. |
| `collapsed` | `string[]` | no | `blockId`s collapsed to a gutter tab at this breakpoint and up. |
| `variants` | `Record<string, string>` | no | Per-block widget variant override (`blockId` → variant, e.g. list↔cards↔table). |
| `collapseStyle` | `LayoutCollapseStyle` | no | Collapse motion for panes collapsed at this breakpoint (WS6, #875). One of the closed `LayoutCollapseStyle` set; absent ⇒ `DEFAULT_COLLAPSE_STYLE` (`gutter-tabs`). |

_Source: `packages/crouton-core/app/types/layout.ts`_
